response.text: {"summary":"The original bug was reproduced and the fix guards against it with no regressions found, but Break My Fix found that days_in_month(year=2200, month=2) still returns 29, so the leap-year logic appears to handle 2100 but not other century years. Look next at the century/400-year rule in billing.calendar.days_in_month and add a test covering years like 2200 and 2000.","flag_notes":[]}
